court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class, Court No.5, Chandrapur
case_name: Sushant Sunilchandra Das vs Saraswati Sushant Das
facts_of_case: Petitioner-husband challenged order granting interim maintenance to respondent-wife; earlier order under Section 23 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 directed petitioner-husband to pay Rs.10,000/- per month.

legal_principles.principle: The grant of maintenance pendente lite should consider the earlier order granting similar relief.
legal_principles.held: Although the challenge in the instant writ petition is with respect to the order passed in the Hindu Marriage Petition, since the basic contention of the petitioner-husband is based on the non-consideration of the order passed in the proceedings under the Act of 2005

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to comply with an earlier order can be considered while granting subsequent relief.
legal_principles.held: For the past one year, the petitioner-husband is in arrears of the amount of Rs.10,000/- per month granted in the Domestic Violence case
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 23

outcome.final_order: Petitioner-husband directed to deposit arrears of maintenance as per order passed in Domestic Violence case at rate of Rs.10,000/- per month till today in this Court within a period of two weeks from today.

keywords: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
use_for_drafting: representing clients in domestic violence cases
